title: Towards resurgence of Joyce structures
summary: Given a Joyce structure, we show that the associated $\mathbb{C}^*$-family of non-linear connections $\mathcal{A}^ε$ can be gauged to a standard form $\mathcal{A}^{ε,\text{st}}$ by a gauge transformation $\hat{g}$, formal in $ε$. We show that the corresponding infinitesimal gauge transformation $\dot{g}=\log(\hat{g})$ has a convergent Borel transform, provided $\dot{g}$ vanishes on the base of the Joyce structure.
